name: After § 14
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 14a. Notes the decision at COP28 to establish the loss and damage fund; calls on all Parties to ensure the transparency of the fund’s rules and to minimise the administrative and financial burden of implementing and financing it; stresses that transparent processes are crucial for accessing funds and for their effective delivery, as they strengthen community-level accountability and build trust between donors and beneficiaries; highlights the need to establish clear sanctions for misuse of funds;
